---
name: brd-feedback
description: Apply an exported feedback file (with Answered by names) to the step it belongs to, as the next round
agent: BRD Reconstruction
---
Read the newest file in `brd-work/feedback/` (or the one I name). Find the step and round it belongs to from its contents, and follow [review-loop.md](../../playbook/review-loop.md) §3 and [people-and-confirmations.md](../../playbook/people-and-confirmations.md): Agree = accepted as written; Correct it or a typed answer = the person's statement; record the name in `answered_by` with each. Write the next round of that step's review page, then stop.
